newsitem.title: UK: Emery launches own Austrian operation.
newsitem.headline: Emery launches own Austrian operation.

text.p: Emery Worldwide began its first wholly owned operations in Austria on June 2 offering air freight and logistics services, the company said in a statement.
It had previously been represented by Gebrueder Weiss Gmbh of Vienna.

The company's division manager for Eastern Europe, Switzerland and Austria, Steve Soukup told Reuters that it hoped to be ranked within the top 10 International Air Transport Association (IATA) cargo forwarders in Austria within two years.
He declined to give more precise details as to the target for Emery's share of the Austrian market.
Key sectors for Emery are expected to be exports and imports for the automotive industry, the apparel, retail and textile sector as well as aerospace and airlines, he added.
Walter Wildner has been appointed general manager-Austria and initially 15 staff will be employed at rising to 35 in two year's time, Soukup said.
"Vienna is the gateway to Eastern and Central Europe. We view its geographical situation as an advantage for overall expansion in that area," he added.

Soukup also said that the company's Hungarian unit which started in June 1996: "was doing very well and we are very happy with that operation .... and the unit was profitable in its first six months and that continued into the first quarter of 1997."
The automotive and apparel, retail and textile market are key areas for the Hungarian market, he said.
Soukup said that it had also won business from Japanese firms operating in Hungary including Sony TDK and Panasonic.

A senior Emery Japanese representative has been based in London since January this year and already visited Hungary four times in support of Japan clients, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
